about_the_game:
In Fields of Fortune, you start out on a small island with just a few tools and the idea of building something from scratch. You plant crops, place buildings, and slowly turn your patch of land into a working little farm.

As you progress, you unlock new things: crafting tools, refining materials, and exploring other islands for rare resources. You can travel to the city to sell your goods or take on small tasks for extra rewards.

Animals are part of your farm too – you feed and water them, build pens, and collect what they produce. Whether you like to play at your own pace or plan things out for maximum efficiency is completely up to you.

What to expect:

  • A calm pixel world focused on farming, crafting, and animal care

  • Buildings and paths that you can place wherever you like

  • Randomly generated islands with new plants and materials

  • Trading in the city and optional tasks with extra rewards

  • A simple cooking system with real recipes

  • No stress – just a game you can take at your own speed

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Dual-Core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 2 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Onboard-Grafikkarte (Intel HD Graphics oder vergleichbar)

short_description: Build your own farm on a remote island, grow crops, refine resources, care for animals and explore new regions. Fields of Fortune is a relaxing 2D pixel game with crafting, cooking, trading, animal care and thoughtful details.
